name: ClipGS
definition: A Gaussian Splatting-based framework that renders volumetric medical data with clipping planes, using a learnable truncation scheme to adjust Gaussian visibility and an Adaptive Adjustment Model (AAM) to predict dynamic deformations based on the clipping plane position.
summary: ClipGS is a Gaussian Splatting framework for real-time volumetric medical visualization that uses learnable truncation and an adaptive adjustment model to maintain rendering quality during interactive clipping.
